name: bonniss26/lqip
description: Framework-agnostic LQIP (low-quality image placeholder) generator: dominant colour, CSS gradient, blurred thumbnail, ThumbHash and CSS-only modes, on GD or Imagick. No dependencies.

suggest.ext-gd: The baseline image driver. One of ext-gd or ext-imagick is required at runtime.
suggest.ext-imagick: Faster driver: decodes JPEG at reduced size instead of the full bitmap. Preferred automatically when loaded.
